points.text: Is the Arabic text easy to read at phone size?
Does the layout read right to left, with the start of each row on the right?
Do the arrows and chevrons point the right way for Arabic?
Do the numbers and amounts read correctly, with the currency beside the right figure?
Are the four orders easy to tell apart at a glance?
Does the order number #A-10293 keep its hash and order intact?
Do the Gregorian and Hijri dates sit together and read in a sensible order?
Is the SAR total readable, with the currency beside the right figure?
Can you tell delivered, on the way and cancelled apart without relying on colour alone?
Do the status labels sit on a consistent side of each order?
